The image shows a single elongated leaf with:
- Diffuse, whitish-gray powdery patches distributed across the upper leaf surface
- No discrete lesions with defined margins (rules out Anthracnose)
- No necrotic tip/branch death (rules out Die_Back)
- No uniform sooty/black coating (rules out Sooty_Mould)
- The grayish-white, dusty, superficial growth pattern is characteristic of fungal mycelium on the leaf surface

This matches Powdery Mildew — a fungal disease that produces white to grayish powdery spots/patches on leaf surfaces.
